todo:1.task_title: **Parity table** mapping every service in `compose.yaml` → free-tier cloud equivalent + constraint. Rows (read compose.yaml to confirm details): postgres (postgres:17-alpine) → Render Postgres free / Neon free tier — constraint: ephemeral disk on Render free, Neon autosuspend; redis (redis:7-alpine) → Upstash free tier — constraint: 10k cmds/day, REST-vs-RESP protocol note for Streams (XADD/XREADGROUP need RESP, Upstash supports it); mlflow (ghcr.io/mlflow/mlflow:v2.13.0 w/ postgres backend) → options: (a) MLflow on Render Free w/ SQLite (loses multi-writer, fine for solo) or (b) skip hosted registry, promote via CI artifacts — constraint: no persistent artifact disk on free tiers; api (built from Dockerfile, uvicorn pitwall_api.main:app) → Render Free web service from GHCR image `ghcr.io/arfaouiahmed1/pitwall-api:latest` (already published by .github/workflows/publish-api.yml) — constraint: spins down after 15m idle ~30s cold start, ephemeral FS means artifacts/ must be baked into image at build; prometheus (prom/prometheus:v2.53.1) + grafana (grafana/grafana:11.1.0, profile monitoring) → Grafana Cloud free tier (hosted Prometheus w/ remote_write from local or Render) — constraint: scrape of localhost API needs public URL or Grafana Agent; web (apps/web Next.js static export) → GitHub Pages — ALREADY LIVE at https://arfaouiahmed1.github.io/PitWall-ML/ via .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml.
